life_stages.student: Learning years: study, training, early adulthood (brahmacarya)

safety_flags.war: Speaks of fighting, killing or battle. Never present as advice to harm anyone.
safety_flags.death: Speaks of death or the deathless self. Handle with care for grieving or at-risk users.
safety_flags.renunciation: Recommends giving up worldly life, work or family ties. Do not present as advice to abandon responsibilities.
safety_flags.under18_hold: Do not show to users under 18 without human-reviewed framing. Applies whenever a verse presents death as harmless, urges fighting, or urges leaving family or the world.
safety_flags.distress_gentle: Could deepen self-blame or hopelessness in someone who is struggling. Present gently, never as a rebuke.
safety_flags.caste_gender: Ranks people by varna (caste) or gender. Present only with reviewed framing, never as endorsement.
safety_flags.fatalism: Presents outcomes as fixed by fate or past deeds. Never offered to anyone in distress or under 18; never used to discourage effort or acceptance of help.
